metric: physical lines, counted as wc -l counts them (newline-terminated lines)

C1.justification: consolidation. The five consumers are anamnesis/steering/screens.py, anamnesis/steering/gates.py, anamnesis/steering/readouts.py, anamnesis/scripts/steer_vectors.py (the golden-path-6 entry point) and tests/test_steering_vectors.py; the five donor scripts stay in the frozen record, where their banks were built. Where two donors disagreed the primary donor's convention won and both are reachable: the paired and unpaired mean-difference laws are separate functions, and the pooled-within-class and injection-target covariance estimators are named separately rather than defaulted.

C4.justification: capability: ported as instrument capability rather than as a consolidation (ruling 5, 2026-09-20), so the arithmetic is reported beside the consumer count and neither number stands alone. The one consumer is tests/test_text_stats.py; no module under anamnesis/ reads it yet, and the scripts that read the donors stay in the frozen record.

C5.justification: consolidation. The one consumer is tests/test_audit_lib.py; the seven scripts that read the three donor modules stay in the frozen record, which is where their results were produced.
